title: AVA: Agentic Variant Adjudication for Automated, Auditable Read-Level Review in Cancer Diagnostic Sequencing
abstract: arXiv:2611.14560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying a tumor's DNA mutations is central to cancer diagnosis and treatment, but distinguishing genuine mutations from sequencing artifacts is error-prone. In practice, genuine mutations are identified using fixed variant-allele-frequency (VAF) and depth thresholds which cannot separate artifacts from genuine mutations in the borderline low-VAF zone where they overlap. A laboratory specialist must manually inspect the read-level sequencing data, a slow step that has high inter-rater variability and causes diagnosis delays. We present AVA: Agentic Variant Adjudication; an agentic framework that automates this read-level inspection with subagents that reason over evidence, generate investigative code, and return a real-or-artifact adjudications with an auditable reasoning trace all without training on existing data. translated_title: AVA：用于癌症诊断测序中自动化、可审计的读段级审查的智能体变异裁决
translated_abstract: 识别肿瘤的DNA突变对癌症的诊断和治疗至关重要，但将真正的突变与测序伪影区分开来容易出错。在实践中，真正的突变是通过固定的变异等位基因频率（VAF）和测序深度阈值来判定的，而这些阈值无法在真实突变与伪影重叠的临界低VAF区域中将二者区分开来。实验室专家必须手动检查读段级的测序数据，这一步骤不仅缓慢、评分者间差异大，还会造成诊断延误。我们提出了AVA（Agentic Variant Adjudication，智能体变异裁决）：一个智能体框架，通过子智能体自动执行这种读段级检查——这些子智能体对证据进行推理、生成调查代码，并返回真突变或伪影的裁决结果，同时提供可审计的推理轨迹，且全部无需在现有数据上进行训练。在SEQC2 DNA测序基准和患者RNA测序数据上，仅针对真实突变与伪影重叠的临界变异子样本进行评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的智能体框架AVA，通过具备证据推理、代码生成和可审计推理轨迹能力的子智能体，自动完成癌症诊断测序中临界低VAF变异的读段级审查，从而替代缓慢且主观性强的人工判读，区分真实突变与测序伪影。
en_tdlr: AVA is a training-free agentic framework that automates read-level review of borderline low-VAF variants in cancer diagnostic sequencing, using subagents that reason over evidence, generate investigative code, and deliver real-versus-artifact adjudications with auditable reasoning traces, replacing slow and variable manual inspection.
